# Atmos Weather

> A simple weather lookup app: current conditions, hourly and 3-day forecast, sunrise/sunset and moon phase for any searched city.

Atmos Weather has no user accounts and does not track visitors. City searches are proxied server-side to WeatherAPI.com; background photography comes from Pixabay. Favorite cities are stored only in the visitor's own browser.

## Pages

- [Privacy Policy](/frontend/privacy.html): what data is and isn't collected.
- [Terms of Service](/frontend/terms.html): terms of use.
